goal.objective: Transport-only BirdAI Qwen smoke test. Do not inspect, search, read, or modify repository files. Do not call repository tools. Immediately call structured_output exactly once with a schema-valid diagnosis, strategy, and summary confirming that this is a read-only smoke execution and that no repository change was attempted.
goal.pass_definition: Qwen immediately returns the required structured_output contract, makes no repository changes, and clean-worktree validation exits 0.
